svg.title: OIDC Portal Complete Data Flow (DNS → TLS → Browser Login → Protected Content)

g.text: - Manages DNS records via Route53 API
• AWS Load Balancer: Outside OpenShift Cluster
② Initial request (no cookie) → OIDCPolicy check
③ 302 Redirect to Keycloak login page
④ User enters credentials → Keycloak validates
⑤ Keycloak returns authorization code → redirect to callback
⑥ OIDCPolicy exchanges code for tokens
⑦ Set session cookie → redirect to original URL
⑧ Subsequent requests use cookie → protected content
